entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr
observations: The 524-aa query sequence has 41.4% identity over 88.4% query coverage to reviewed Mycobacterium leprae Nnr (UniProt P37391; E-value 2.74e-74).
Reviewed Nnr annotations describe NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of S-NAD(P)HX, repairing hydrated NAD(P)H cofactors; potassium is annotated as a cofactor.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 53.1 kDa; theoretical pI 6.32; GRAVY 0.292; instability index 34.8. Function is inferred by homology, not experimentally demonstrated for the query.
